subject: POC Observability Plan & Success Criteria — FintechX
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: POC Observability Plan & Success Criteria — FintechX

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned on the POC: 

Summary from call:
- Scope: 4-week POC to validate performance and operability of Redwood inference for FintechX’s customer support assistant workload.
- Primary goals: validate latency/throughput at expected traffic, verify integration with FintechX tracing/logging, and confirm cost profile.

Proposed success criteria (draft):
1) Latency: P95 <= 200ms across typical 512-token requests under expected concurrency.
2) Throughput: sustain 40 req/s steady-state with <= 5% error rate.
3) Observability: streaming traces and logs exported to FintechX ELK (or equivalent) with KV/cache hit metrics visible.
4) Quality: pass rate >= 92% on your 50-manual prompt checks (we’ll run the set).

Observability plan highlights we discussed:
- Dashboards: latency P50/P95/P99, tokens per response, token cost, error rate, model version traffic split, cache hit rate.
- Tracing: include request id propagation, model internal spans (tokenization, model forward, kv cache hits), end-to-end latency.
- Logs/exports: structured JSON logs (level/timestamp/request_id/route/token_count); option to stream to your Kafka/ELK or Redshift.
- Alerts: P95 latency > 250ms for 5m, error rate > 3% for 5m, cache hit rate < 60%.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Confirm instrumentation target (ELK/Datadog/Splunk) and retention.
2) Kickoff integration call (30–45m) — propose Tues 2026-02-24 10:00 PT.
3) Redwood to deliver a one-page observability checklist + small sample dashboard by EOD 2026-02-21. (See attachment).
4) Assignment: FintechX owners: Sarah (Product, success criteria) and Tom (Platform, logs/tracing). Redwood owners: Marcus (AE), Marissa (CS), Monica (SRE/SE).

I attached a short POC observability plan PDF with the checklist and sample Grafana panels. Please confirm the kickoff time and any edits to success criteria.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: redwood-poc-observability-plan.pdf (1 page)

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@fintechx.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@fintechx.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC Observability Plan & Success Criteria — FintechX

Thanks Marcus — this looks good and captures the discussion. A few notes:

- Confirmed owners: Sarah (me) for product/quality, Tom for infra/logs.
- We can provide tracing to Datadog; logs to our ELK cluster (retention: default 90 days).
- One small ask on success criteria: can we track a business metric (mean time to resolution delta) as a secondary quality signal? We’ll provide baseline within the next week.

Kickoff time Tue 02/24 10:00 PT works for Tom and me. Looking forward to the sample dashboard.

Cheers,
Sarah Li
Head of Product | FintechX
sarah.li@fintechx.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@fintechx.com>
Date: 2026-02-21T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC Observability Plan & Success Criteria — FintechX

Great — thanks for the quick confirmation, Sarah.

Attached is the lightweight POC observability plan PDF (redwood-poc-observability-plan.pdf) and a link to the shared drive with the sample Grafana dashboard JSON and a short runbook: https://drive.google.com/fintechx-poc-observability-plan

Key items in the plan (TL;DR):
- Week 0 (Kickoff, 02/24): finalize endpoints, auth, and logging/tracing integration approach.
- Week 1 (Integration): SDK/instrumentation + test harness for your 50 prompts; create dashboards and set up log export.
- Week 2 (Load & validation): run load pattern (40 req/s target), capture metrics, run prompt suite for quality checks.
- Week 3 (Analysis & tuning): analyze cache settings, batching/quantization options; iterate on config.
- Week 4 (Wrap & decision): present results vs success criteria; recommended next steps.

Observability specifics we’ll enable for the POC:
- Metrics exported: request_count, error_count, tokens_in/out, latency_ms (p50/p95/p99), cache_hit_rate, kv_cache_size, model_version.
- Tracing: OpenTelemetry spans; we’ll propagate x-request-id and include tokenization/model spans.
- Logs: structured JSON to your ELK (we support Kafka/Fluentd shipping if needed).

Open questions for Tom (cc’d):
1) Confirm log ingestion path and any proxying required.
2) Do you have an allowlist for outbound endpoints (we can support VPC peering or a secure export tunnel)?
3) Retention/PII policies for logs — we can redact tokens at source if needed.

Action items before kickoff:
- FintechX: share one sample production request/response (anonymized) and baseline MTTD metric.
- Redwood: finalize dashboard JSON and runbook (we’ll post to the Drive link above).

If agreed, I’ll send a calendar invite for Tues 02/24 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Marcus

Attachment: redwood-poc-observability-plan.pdf

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@fintechx.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Questions on log export & data retention

Thanks Marcus — a couple of infra questions before the kickoff: 

1) Log export format: you mentioned structured JSON logs. Can you share a sample log schema (fields and examples)?
2) Retention & PII: our security team needs confirmation that user prompt text can be redacted prior to export and that token-level logs can be disabled.
3) Network: do you require any inbound firewall rules for the exports, or can we initiate to your endpoints? Any support for VPC peering?

We’re happy to cover these in the kickoff but wanted clarity up front.

-Tom
Platform Engineering | FintechX
tom.nguyen@fintechx.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Internal: FintechX POC — pre-kickoff tasks and owners

Team — prepping for Tue kickoff (02/24 10:00 PT). Please see assignments: 
- Marissa (CS): own the kickoff agenda, collect FintechX sample prompts, and coordinate baseline MTTD from Sarah.
- Monica (SE): finalize Grafana dashboard JSON, OpenTelemetry config, and the runbook for log shipping (include redaction pattern).
- Rishi (SRE): prepare a short note on expected backend capacity tuning and cache defaults; include suggested autoscale thresholds.
- Marcus (AE): send calendar invite and confirm Datadog/ELK endpoints with Tom.

Deliverables due by EOD 02/24 morning PT so we can walk through during the kickoff. I uploaded the current plan and dashboard to the shared drive link in the thread.

Thanks,
Marcus
